text: Return approved drugs with a COVID-19 indication. Select the drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and indication details. Source from molecule_dictionary and drug_indication. Join on molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno. Filter for approved drugs (molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4) and COVID-19 indications (drug_indication.mesh_heading LIKE '%COVID-19%' OR drug_indication.efo_term LIKE '%COVID-19%'). Return all matching rows.
